title: ProjectSummary
description: One row in the Home project list.

accessed_at.description: Last-opened timestamp in UTC ISO-8601 form.

completed_videos.description: Videos whose concatenated output exists and is non-empty, derived at read time.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp in UTC ISO-8601 form.

id.description: Stable project identifier: a UUID v4 string, also the directory name.

path.description: Filesystem path to the project directory.

size_bytes.description: Total bytes occupied by the project and its temporary data.

video_count.description: Number of videos currently in the project queue.
